description: Shared policy across the MatterWave repos. Pip/uv ecosystem (pyproject.toml and uv.lock). rangeStrategy is 'auto' (not 'pin') because these repos commit lockfiles while manifests keep version ranges: Renovate updates the range in the manifest and the resolved version in the lockfile together.

packageRules.description: All minor+patch updates grouped into a single PR per ecosystem.

Security updates need no extra rule: with vulnerabilityAlerts enabled, Renovate natively raises dedicated immediate PRs for vulnerable dependencies, bypassing the weekend schedule and the minor+patch group, labelled security.
nexusql is pinned exactly on purpose — the platform's locked dependency. Renovate must not touch it.
